348% peak conversion growth · Bajaj Finserv

A "conversion" is when a visitor stops browsing and actually buys or signs up. Out of the same crowd walking past the shop, I got 4.5× more people to walk in and buy: for every 100 sales the old pages produced, the reworked journeys produced 448. And it happened while cutting the ad bill by 60%.

How I got there
1Found the exact search phrases buyers use when they're ready to act (not just browsing), and built a keyword portfolio around them.
2Rebuilt the landing journeys around those intents: one page, one promise, one obvious next step.
3Moved budget from what looked good to what measurably sold, week after week.
270K LinkedIn community · HighRadius

Followers are subscribers: people who chose to see the brand in their feed every day. I grew that audience from 150K to 270K in 9 months, and not with giveaways: I analysed 10,000+ job titles so the 35K new followers were the exact finance professionals the company sells to.

How I got there
1Mapped who actually buys the product (10K+ job titles analysed) and what they engage with.
2Built a content engine around those personas: formats, hooks and timing tuned by data.
3Compounded reach through employees and events until the page outranked every competitor.
$149K pipeline in one month · Centime

Pipeline means real sales conversations with a dollar value attached, not clicks or likes. The content engine I run brought in 22 potential customers worth $149K in 30 days: people who read our answers, trusted them, and asked for a demo.

How I got there
1Wrote content that answers the exact bottom-of-funnel questions buyers ask before purchasing.
2Made it findable everywhere buyers look: Google, and now AI assistants (13 AI Overview citations in 90 days).
3Routed every reader signal into sales follow-up, so content got credit and reps got warm leads.
1.8M organic impressions · Aviso AI

An impression is one appearance in one person's feed. 1.8 million appearances without paying for a single ad: I turned 200+ employees and 50+ advisors into the media channel, each sharing content their networks actually wanted to read.

How I got there
1Ghostwrote for the CEO and packaged company stories people would share on their own profiles.
2Ran an advocacy programme: ready-to-post content, timed pushes, leaderboards.
3Reinvested what worked: doubled down on formats that earned reach instead of renting it.
Organic became the #1 inbound channel · Centime

Of all the leads the sales team accepted as genuinely worth pursuing, 28% came from people finding our content in search: a bigger share than any other channel, paid included. That means the content isn't decoration. It's the front door.

How I got there
1Audited what buyers search at every funnel stage and filled every gap with a definitive answer.
2Optimised for AI search (AEO/GEO) before competitors: 0 → 13 Google AI Overview citations in 90 days.
3Tracked every lead back to its source so 'organic works' became a number, not a feeling.
+$75K incremental event revenue · HighRadius

The Radiance conference sells tickets, and tickets are revenue you can count. My social campaigns alone drove 120 registrations worth $75K that wouldn't have happened otherwise: measured, attributed, banked.

How I got there
1Mined the follower base for people who matched past attendee profiles.
2Ran creative sprints: speaker reveals, countdowns, FOMO clips tuned to each persona.
3Timed conversion windows with urgency offers, and tracked every registration to its post.

Journey

Career timeline.

🎖️
About the moves: I'm an army kid.

My father served in the Indian Army, and I grew up the way army families do: packing up every posting and starting over in a new city. My early career maps those relocations across Hyderabad, Noida, Pune and Delhi. Read the timeline with that in mind, because the pattern that matters isn't the moves. It's that in every city, at every company, I left behind a number that wasn't there before: +348% conversions, a Top-3 e-book, +50% organic traffic, 270K followers. Remote-first and settled since 2024.
